alchemistaccelerator-siro:ashbyhq:0bbc84.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
alchemistaccelerator-siro:ashbyhq:0bbc84.description: Field sales powers the economy — but most teams are struggling. Reps are buried in admin work, managers are stretched thin, and leaders can’t see what’s really happening in the field. Siro is redefining how field sales teams learn, perform, and win. We started as an AI-powered coaching platform that helped reps improve their outcomes in the field. Today, we’re something much bigger — an intelligent companion that automates sales reps’ tedious admin work, gives managers real-time visibility, and helps executives see around corners. Our platform integrates with systems like Salesforce, analyzing thousands of in-person sales conversations to surface insights, automate workflows, and drive better outcomes across the org. Think Iron Man’s Jarvis for sales — proactive, personalized, and built directly into the tools teams already use. Siro has raised $75M and is backed by world-class investors like Index, Fika, CRV, and SignalFire. We are trusted by leading home-improvement, retail, hospitality, and automotive brands, and powered by a lean team from Meta, McKinsey, Doordash, and Uber. We’re building the future of human-AI collaboration in sales — and we’re just getting started. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Build platform and backend systems at Siro, across recording, integrations, AI agents, and more! - Own the end-to-end development of key features, from architectural decisions through implementation, deployment, and support - Design and build scalable backend services that handle real-time processing of sales conversations - Drive technical excellence through thoughtful code reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices - Partner closely with product and design teams to transform customer needs into elegant technical solutions - Own the health of our systems and products, and make data-driven decisions - Help evolve our development practices and tooling to enable sustainable scaling while maintaining velocity REQUIREMENTS - We expect 10+ years of professional software engineering experience. - You are excited to work in our NYC office 3+ days a week with the rest of the team. - You have strong proficiency in modern programming languages, databases, API frameworks, and cloud platforms (like GCP) - You are a strong problem solver, with the ability to think critically and approach challenges with a first-principles mindset. - You have strong communication skills, able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. OUR TECH STACK In case you’re curious, we use the following technologies (and more), but proficiency in any specific technology is not required. - Frontend: Next.js, React Native, TypeScript - Mobile: Swift, Kotlin - Backend: Node.js, Typescript, serverless functions - Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - Other tools: Git, Datadog, Figma WHY JOIN SIRO? - Growth: Join a rapidly scaling Series B startup with proven product-market fit - Technology: Work with cutting-edge AI technologies and a modern tech stack - Team: Collaborate with an experienced CEO (previously built a successful sales tool used by 100,000+ reps) and top-tier team - Ownership: Take end-to-end ownership of features that directly impact our users - Learning: Work across the full stack and grow your technical breadth - Impact: Help democratize sales success and create opportunities for millions of sales professionals WHAT SETS YOU APART - You're a collaborative team player with a "we before me" mindset, always ready to support and elevate your colleagues. - You have high standards for excellence and aren't afraid to voice your opinion to push for quality. - You think strategically beyond code, considering business and design implications in your work. - You actively leverage AI coding tools to assist you during development. - You thrive in an agile environment with low management overhead. - You're creative and can think outside the box to solve complex problems in innovative ways. - You continuously look to grow

alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:9d293c95-8.title: Immigration & Mobility Lead
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:9d293c95-8.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE Baseten is building a world-class team, anchored in our San Francisco and New York offices and increasingly growing across the globe. We believe the best talent can come from anywhere, and our ability to hire and support that talent is mission-critical. As our Immigration and Mobility Lead, you will make global hiring operationally seamless. You’ll be Baseten’s in-house expert on immigration, relocation, and international employment strategy, ensuring that exceptional candidates from all over the world can confidently build their careers with us. This is a high-stakes, high-impact role. Speed, clarity, and correctness matter deeply in immigration and mobility. You will own the end-to-end experience, navigate a rapidly evolving U.S. immigration landscape, and design the systems and policies that enable Baseten to hire globally while delivering an exceptional employee experience. Over time, you’ll also help shape where and how we expand internationally, advising on global hiring models, new hubs, and employment structures that support our long-term growth. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own the end-to-end immigration lifecycle, managing all U.S. visa processes (e.g., H-1B, O-1, J-1, TN, E-3, L-1, EB-2/3 PERM) from offer stage through renewals and permanent residency. - Oversee and project manage visa sponsorships executed through Employer of Record (EOR) partners - Serve as Baseten’s internal immigration expert, partnering closely with external counsel and vendors where needed. - Stay closely attuned to changes in the U.S. immigration landscape and translate them into clear, practical guidance for employees and leadership. - Design a relocation experience that feels seamless and well-supported, helping employees and their families successfully land in San Francisco, New York, or other global locations - Advise on international hiring and employment arrangements, bringing strong knowledge of cross-border tax implications, compliance considerations, and global mobility tradeoffs - Partner with Legal, Finance, and People to support international expansion and the establishment of future global hubs. - Build thoughtful, scalable processes, documentation, and internal education that make immigration and mobility feel organized, transparent, and human. REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years of hands-on experience managing U.S. and Canadian business immigration across a wide range of visa types and permanent residency pathways. - Proven ability to navigate complex, high-stakes immigration scenarios with exceptional judgment, discretion, and attention to detail. - Deep, current knowledge of the evolving U.S. immigration landscape, with a proactive approach to monitoring and responding to policy changes. - Strong experience advising on international employment arrangements, including cross-border compliance and employment tax considerations. - Experience building and maintaining scalable internal documentation, knowledge bases, and audit-ready case tracking systems. - Exceptional communicator (proactive, clear, and empathetic) who inspires confidence in employees and their families during high-uncertainty processes. - Highly organized operator who can manage multiple concurrent cases with speed and precision without sacrificing quality. - High-ownership, systems-oriented leader who can operate effectively in both structured environments and fast-scaling sta

bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:9467eb67-edc2-.title: Senior Identity Access Engineer
bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:9467eb67-edc2-.description: Overview We are seeking a Senior AI Automation & Identity Engineer to lead and scale workforce identity automation across our enterprise environment. This role will own end-to-end identity lifecycle workflows, SSO/MFA integrations, and identity governance initiatives spanning HRIS, IdP, and downstream SaaS platforms. You’ll partner closely with IT, Security, and Compliance teams to improve reliability, automation, and audit readiness across the identity stack while helping shape future-state identity architecture and operational standards. Candidates should have 6+ years of experience in identity engineering, IAM automation, or enterprise identity infrastructure roles.
responsibilities: Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain identity lifecycle automations, including joiner/mover/leaver workflows and SCIM provisioning.
Own SSO and MFA integrations across enterprise SaaS applications.
Design and support integrations between HRIS, identity providers, and downstream systems.
Drive operational excellence for identity infrastructure through monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident response.
Partner with Security teams on conditional access policies, privileged access patterns, and identity governance controls.
Serve as a primary technical contributor for ITGC and SOX audit activities related to identity systems, including evidence collection, control walkthroughs, and remediation efforts.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to identity engineering standards, tooling strategy, and automation best practices.
Must-Haves
6+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity Engineering, or related infrastructure/security engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with Okta Identity Engine, Microsoft Entra ID, and Active Directory-integrated environments.
Deep understanding of authentication and federation protocols including SCIM, SAML, OAuth, and OIDC.
Experience building API-driven automations and scripting solutions using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
Experience implementing and supporting SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning workflows at enterprise scale.
Direct experience supporting ITGC/SOX audits and identity-related compliance controls.
Strong troubleshooting, systems integration, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Okta Certification
Nice-to-Haves
Experience integrating HRIS platforms such as Workday with identity systems.
Familiarity with conditional access frameworks, FIDO2, TOTP, and modern authentication/security controls.
Experience with observability, alerting, and operational monitoring for identity platforms.
Exposure to privileged access management (PAM) or zero trust initiatives.
Experience leveraging AI or workflow automation tooling to improve IT operations and identity workflows.
Prior experience mentoring engineers or contributing to identity architecture standards.
What Success Looks Like
Operates autonomously across complex identity and automation initiatives.
Improves scalability, reliability, and audit readiness across the identity ecosystem.
Contributes strategic input into identity tooling, governance, and automation direction.
Raises the technical maturity of identity operations through automation and engineering best practices.

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:3d48b94a-71b.description: About the Role We’re hiring a VA Engagement & Retention Partner to strengthen Wing’s virtual assistant (VA) retention pipeline by ensuring candidates stay engaged and committed from offer to onboarding — and remain satisfied in their first 30–60 days. This role combines proactive relationship management with structured engagement rituals to prevent back-outs, early drop-offs, and silent disengagement, ultimately improving overall retention and workforce stability.

ghj-ghj:lever:11bb09ed-f60b-4251-a602-ee.title: Controller - Farming
ghj-ghj:lever:11bb09ed-f60b-4251-a602-ee.description: GHJ Search & Staffing is working with a well-established, large-scale agricultural organization who is seeking an experienced Controller to lead accounting and financial operations supporting its farming business. This is a key leadership position for an accounting professional who understands the complexities of cost accounting, inventory tracking, and operational finance within agriculture, manufacturing, or another inventory-intensive environment. The Controller will oversee the farming accounting function while partnering closely with finance and operational leadership to improve financial visibility, analyze operating performance, strengthen controls, and provide meaningful information to support business decisions. This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to the operations and can balance hands-on technical accounting expertise with leadership, analytics, and strategic partnership. Lead and develop the farm accounting team, ensuring timely and accurate accounting and financial reporting across a multi-entity environment. Oversee crop and farm cost accounting, including cost accumulation, allocations, standard rates, raw product entries, inventory tracking, and planting/listing activities. Oversee and review inventory accounting and reconciliations, ensuring accurate tracking, valuation, balance sheet reporting, and financial integrity. Monitor and analyze financial information related to harvesting and packout operations to ensure accurate cost allocations. Analyze financial and operational results, identify trends, explain variances, and forecast costs. Partner with operations and finance leadership on budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and strategic decision support. Develop and utilize ERP reports, data queries, dashboards, and reporting tools to improve operational and financial visibility. Strengthen internal controls, accounting processes, and procedures while identifying opportunities for greater efficiency. Participate in budgeting and planning for farming operations. Ensure compliance with GAAP and company accounting policies and support financial audits. Lead special projects focused on improving financial reporting, operational transparency, and accounting processes. Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and staff development. Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. 5+ years of directly related accounting or finance experience within agriculture, manufacturing, or another inventory-intensive environment. Cost accounting experience is required, including cost accumulation, allocations, and cost forecasting. Inventory accounting and tracking experience is required, including reconciliations, valuation, tracking, and related financial reporting. Strong understanding of operational accounting and the ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights. Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and developing accounting professionals. Strong budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting capabilities. Experience working with ERP systems and developing reports or data queries for financial and operational analysis. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Exposure to data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI or Tableau is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of GAAP, internal controls, and accounting best practices. Excellent communication, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Ability to succeed in a fast-paced, changing, operationally focused environment. Ability to work fully onsite in Shafter, CA and travel to regional facilities as needed. #GHJSS #LI-MO1

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:7b1682ad-3ccd-4681.title: Power Systems Applications Engineer
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:7b1682ad-3ccd-4681.description: Power Systems Applications Engineer Location: Marietta, OH Job Type: Direct Hire Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Applications Engineer to support the design, application, and integration of electrical power distribution solutions for data center environments. This role works with customers, consultants, contractors, sales, and internal engineering teams to develop practical technical solutions and support projects from initial requirements through startup.
responsibilities: Translate customer requirements into engineered solutions for data center electrical systems.
Prepare submittal packages, proposals, technical documentation, drawings, and compliance materials.
Coordinate order entry and support projects through production, installation, and field startup.
Advise customers and consultants on power distribution and STS applications and best practices.
Troubleshoot technical issues during equipment installation, commissioning, and operation.
Provide technical training and presentations to customers, consultants, and channel partners.
Support product testing, application notes, and competitive analysis for data center solutions.
Gather customer feedback and communicate findings to product development and R&D teams.
Travel to customer sites, job sites, and data center facilities approximately 25–35%.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or a related discipline.
5+ years of applications, field, and/or design engineering experience involving data center electrical infrastructure.
Strong understanding of data center electrical architecture, including UL 891 switchboards, PDUs, STSs, and redundancy strategies such as N+1 and 2N.
Ability to read and interpret electrical one-lines, schematics, and specifications.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to travel domestically as needed.

southparkcommons-meesho:lever:cb16706c-2.title: Engineering Manager -Backend
southparkcommons-meesho:lever:cb16706c-2.description: About Meesho Mission and Vision Meesho is India’s fastest-growing internet commerce company, driven by the mission to democratize internet commerce for everyone (DICE). Our vision is to enable 100 million small businesses and entrepreneurs in India to succeed online, making online commerce accessible to all. This core purpose guides us in empowering sellers across the country and bringing a diverse range of products to first-time internet shoppers. By leveraging technology and a unique zero commission model, Meesho has opened the doors of e-commerce to millions who were previously underserved. Technological Scale & Innovation At Meesho, technology is at the heart of our success. We have invested in a scalable infrastructure and innovative solutions to meet the demands of a vast user base and complex marketplace. Some key highlights include: Massive Scale: Our backend systems handle millions of orders per day from across India, reaching about 5% of all Indian households, all with near-zero downtime to date. Achieving this level of reliability and performance in a hyper-growth environment is a testament to our engineering excellence. Marketplace Reach: Over 1.75 million sellers are registered on Meesho’s platform, supported by our state-of-the-art tech infrastructure and pan-India logistics network. This wide reach — covering virtually every serviceable pin code in the country — presents unique engineering challenges in areas like search, personalization, and payments at scale. Scalable Architecture: We continually innovate our architecture for growth.. Our quest to serve a billion Indian users has helped us evolve our technologies from a monolith to microservices to now a high scale federated architecture. This evolution allows us to build and deploy features rapidly while maintaining stability for a fast-growing user base. Cutting-edge Tech Stack: Our platform is built using modern, open-source technologies on the cloud while ensuring high efficiency. We strategically choose proven tools (for example, Java and Golang for services, Kafka for messaging, Dragonfly and Redis for caching, ScyllaDB, MySQL and Mongo for Data) and leverage GCP infrastructure to ensure high performance, reliability, and flexibility. By focusing on the right tools for the right problems, we innovate pragmatically rather than chasing every new tech hype, which helps us solve real-world problems effectively. Engineering Culture & Challenges Engineering at Meesho is driven by a bold and inclusive culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe that building great products goes hand-in-hand with building a great team. Key aspects of our engineering culture include: Long Term Thinking: We believe in thinking for tomorrow while building for today, this approach has helped us not only to handle and evolve for scale but also focus on extensibility and stability by investing in the platform Lightspeed: We prioritize rapid iteration and delivery. Engineers are encouraged to ship fast and refine continuously, as we value in order to learn and adapt quickly. Continuous Improvement: We view failures and bugs as opportunities to improve. A blameless post-mortem culture ensures that mistakes become lessons, fostering an environment where learning from failure drives resilience and innovation. Ownership Mindset: Every engineer is empowered to act like an owner. We instill a “Founder’s Mindset,” encouraging engineers to take end-to-end ownership of projects and drive them with an entrepreneurial spirit. This means our teams proactively identify problems and champion solutions, just as a founder would for their own product. Engineering at Meesho is more than just writing code – it's about solving complex, impactful problems at an unprecedented scale. Our engineers tackle challenging use cases (from enabling real-time logistics across India to optimizing a vast product catalog for the next billion users), making a tangible impact on milli

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:373d5af1-2d6.title: Swiss French Multimedia Content Reviewer (Music Marketing)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:373d5af1-2d6.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com Job Summary In this exciting position, the Swiss French Multimedia Content Reviewer will be writing and reviewing linguistic content in French from Switzerland to ensure the highest quality of accuracy for customers using the world's foremost multimedia platforms. With time the Multimedia Content Reviewer will become the cultural ambassador for the Swiss market and will be expected to produce fully localized content and flag potential cultural issues with content types, wording and articulate suggestions to make all content appropriate and relevant for the target markets. The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in Media Marketing with an emphasis on Music Marketing, marketing localization, advertising and localization, combined with proven creative writing skills and exceptional attention to detail. We are specifically seeking candidates with deep market expertise of Switzerland, who understand local consumer behavior, marketing trends, cultural nuances, media landscapes, and the music industry ecosystem. Candidates should also demonstrate strong awareness of contemporary music trends, genres, audience preferences, and pop culture relevant to their market. In addition, candidates should be passionate about media, music entertainment, technology and digital marketing ecosystems. This will be a 1-year part-time contract with the possibility of being extended after the contract ends. Main Duties Localize, transcreate and adapt marketing music and media-related content to ensure maximum relevance, engagement and effectiveness for French-speaking Swiss audience while maintaining brand voice and messaging objectives. In addition to Music related marketing copy, you may also be asked to write, review and optimize marketing-oriented copy across multimedia products, digital campaigns, promotional materials, apps, audience-facing communications with strong consideration for local market expectations and cultural relevance. Perform regular linguistic review of their own work as well as the work performed by other members of the localization team for all content types. Copy-edit and fact check content to ensure accuracy of content. Perform LQA (Localization QA) testing of any content published on live platforms (music and app descriptions, marketing material and marketing campaigns). Conducts market-specific research on local content treatment, content, product and terminology trends and best localization practices for the Swiss French locale and market. Report on data and/or assets across a broad scope of media and content types Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for the Swiss French market, providing guidance on marketing language, local consumer preferences, media trends and culturally relevant messaging Collaborate with global language team via virtual meetings, emails on content review tasks to ensure calibrating terminology and style, understanding trends and market specific insights, translations based on the market team's needs. Requirements BS/BA and 2+ years of work experience in Media Marketing, Music Marke
